name: Install Hailo candidate
description: Install a validated local candidate already built for the running kernel on the Pi. Announces downtime and requires a verified NAS backup. Firmware EULA approval must be supplied separately in private host variables. Unlike All on configured HAT hosts, this standalone action never builds after OS work.

spec.question_description: Leave blank to select the newest ready local candidate matching the running kernel, or enter an exact stable 4.x version without v. No candidate means failure before downtime.
600 gives ten minutes. Zero still announces immediately before saving and stopping.
